title: Eliciting Supplier Cooperation for Value Chain Decarbonization: A Field Experiment with Smallholder Farmers in India
eligible_reason: Village-randomized field experiment (control C, arms A and B) with one baseline and one follow-up survey; all villages are treated at the same date. No staggered adoption. 'DID' in Table 3a is a simple two-period difference of means (post-pre change in treated arm minus control) computed with ttests.
design_notes: main_paper.do: Table 3a ttests of pre/post means and DID of changes by arm; Table 3b, 4 and 5 are cross-sectional reghdfe of post-period outcomes (or post-pre changes) on i.treated_cat with baseline farmer and village covariates, absorb(centre_cat), cluster(shrid_cat). online_supplement.do: same structure for secondary outcomes plus randomization-inference/regress with centre dummies.
data_files_note: Code references DTA/village_table.dta and DTA/master_table.dta, which are not in the package. Shipped files: main_paper.do, online_supplement.do, their logs (main_paper.pdf and online_supplement.pdf are Stata log printouts, not the article), Data_Dictionary.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not a staggered design (single-date RCT). No data shipped.
